title: MCStudio
description: A "creator-first" toolkit designed to make the process of video and world creation easier
body:
**MinecraftStudio (MCStudio)** is a modpack/content creation toolkit to aid with the creation of Minecraft videos, films, and worlds. The 3 primary mods in this pack are Flashback, Axiom and Litematica.

[Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback) allows you to record your gameplay on a local or hosted world, edit it in a "Davinci Resolve" style editor, and export the project in various formats. Flashback features multi-camera angles, timeline-based editing, and real-time preview.

[Axiom](https://modrinth.com/mod/axiom) is a multi-tool for designing and creating worlds. Axiom mimics 3D design software, offering a user-friendly interface for building intricate and expansive Minecraft worlds. The capabilities of Axiom include terrain sculpting, blueprint creation, and structure replication, making it an invaluable asset for creators.

[Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) is a modern schematic mod for Minecraft that helps players create and replicate builds with ease. The main feature of Litematica is its ability to display a hologram version of a build, showing you exactly how to build it and where to place the blocks.

**MCStudio** is designed to provide creators with a powerful suite of tools to elevate their Minecraft projects, making it easier than ever to produce professional-quality content.

### **Primary Mod List:**
- Flashback
- Axiom
- Litematica
- Iris / Sodium
- 3D Skin Layers
- Continuity
- LambDynamicLights
- ChatHeads

### Additional Performance Mods:

- Lithium
- Enhanced Block Entities
- Entity Culling
- StutterFix
- ImmediatelyFast
